failure_mode: Diagnostic hooks walking lists or formatting strings on hot paths

symptom: Per-call overhead

component: dsp.rs voice loop (JASAramStream) [partial: music still stops - see G40]

failure_mode: Each new GX blend/Z state compiled a GPU pipeline synchronously on first use
symptom: Hitch when new effects first appear (race countdown numbers)

failure_mode: No dual-texture post transform; at most 4 texture maps and 2 texgens per material (extra stages got UV 0 / white)
symptom: Item boxes rainbow-checkered and opaque without the ?; shine on models wrong

failure_mode: Z copies were box-averaged across 2x2 pixels; vertical copy filter and XFB gamma ignored
symptom: Halo ("glow") around characters and karts through the depth-blur pass
fix: Point-sampled Z copies; copy filter (BP 0x53/0x54) with top/bottom clamp; display gamma (BP 0x52 bits 7-8)

failure_mode: VPB +0x64 is afc_remaining_decoded_samples (Dolphin VPB layout); the DSP never wrote it and read it as 'samples per block'. JASAramStream's play position = remaining + cached jumped by a whole ring at wraps

fix: fixed (verified)

component: gx.rs light_channel [verified: no halo in race screenshots]
failure_mode: GX specular attenuation (attn fn 1) evaluated as no attenuation: every specular light added its full colour over the whole model
symptom: Glow / wash around racers and karts

failure_mode: Per vertex: all lights re-read from XF memory for both channels and matrices re-read per vertex
symptom: Pause screen (full 3D redraw) only ~43 fps; race below 60
probe_evidence_after: pause screen 300 frames/5s (60 fps); race 32-47 fps (guest CPU)

failure_mode: Dev profile kept debug assertions + integer overflow checks on every crate (generated parts / gc-core / Bevy) and compiled the parts incrementally at opt-level 2 (up to 256 codegen units each: little inlining between guest functions)

failure_mode: EFB rendered at the console's native 640x528 and stretched to the window

component: gx.rs draw (GPU thread) at race intro / countdown
failure_mode: Every vertex of every strip was transformed + lit + texgen'd even when the same indexed vertex recurs within the draw (J3D strip meshes repeat records heavily; worst when all 8 racers fill the screen)

failure_mode: ~7,700 tiny draws/frame (~5 verts each): per draw a fresh vertex Vec + cache tables, a full 2 KB lighting setup rebuild, a TevState clone, the vertex format decoded twice, a display-list copy; per vertex texgen info and matrices re-read from XF memory; every strip vertex emitted 3x (116 B each) and re-packed by the renderer
symptom: Race intro camera sweep and countdown at ~44-56 fps

fix: Vertices computed once in the renderer's GPU layout + u32 triangle indices (draw_indexed); reused scratch buffer; vertex formats cached per VAT; lighting cached until XF lighting writes; texgen setup / texture + post matrices / projection decoded once per draw; shared Arc material; display lists decoded in place; TLUT loads as slice copies; vertex cache removed; GX + guest threads at above-normal OS priority
